issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

msgSuffixSettings.description:
Settings related to the message suffix for the demo.
This is part of the {@link UiConfigurabilityDemoMsgSuffixSettings}.

showAlerts.description:
A string representing the setting for showing alerts in the demo.
This could be used to toggle or customize the alert behavior.

gridTitle.description: The title of the grid displayed in the demo.

showSecretToAll.description:
If `true` show the SecretNav.
If `false` hide the SecretNav.

showHiddenTabPanel.description:
If `true` show the HiddenTabPanel.
If `false` hide the HiddenTabPanel.

title:
Configuration type for demo purposes to showcase this package's features.

This config is used for demonstrating various settings such as message suffixes,
alert visibility, grid titles, and the visibility of secret or hidden UI elements.
name: UiConfigurabilityDemoConfig
